audit_metadata.milestone: RC1.4.5.2 Final Release Evidence & Production Readiness Closeout

local_and_ci_verification.scope: Local Source Repository & CI Test Suite
local_and_ci_verification.details: FastAPI middleware strictly enforces zero 'unsafe-inline' scripts (script-src 'self' only), HTTP 307 direct-route redirects, and strict headers across all 242 tests.

current_production_deployment.details: All 6 security headers are present and enforced on Railway edge. However, live CSP on Railway still contains legacy 'unsafe-inline' in script-src from pre-RC1.4.5 deployment.

pending_deployment_verification.details: Strict CSP without 'unsafe-inline' in script-src is fully implemented and verified in branch commit but requires Railway deployment after PR #1 merge.

Strict-Transport-Security.description: Enforced on direct HTTPS or trusted proxy forwarded HTTPS. Omits includeSubDomains for single-domain deployment.

Content-Security-Policy.description: Strict script execution ('self' only, zero unsafe-inline in script-src). Style allows 'unsafe-inline' for dynamic theme variables.

X-Content-Type-Options.description: MIME-sniffing protection across all HTML, JSON, and static assets.

Referrer-Policy.description: Referrer leak protection sending origin only on cross-origin requests.

Permissions-Policy.description: Restricts browser device features to same-origin for assistive sign/voice.
